definitions.business_definition: The single dominant colour a customer would name first when describing this cake's appearance.
definitions.purpose: Drives colour-based merchandising filters and SEO/GEO descriptions that mention a cake's look.
definitions.vision_guidance: Identify the dominant colour of the cake's outer surface (icing/fondant), ignoring small decorations, toppers, or the plate/background.
definitions.ai_guidance: Treat as a single categorical value, not a palette - if multiple colours are equally dominant, prefer the base/icing colour over accent colours.
definitions.mapping_guidance: Maps to a Shopify metafield used in collection filtering and to an ERP SKU attribute code used for kitchen recipe colour matching.

confidence_expectations.notes: Colour is one of the most reliably extracted attributes from a clear product photo.

definitions.business_definition: The category of decorative technique or element applied to the cake (e.g. piped, fondant figures, edible print).
definitions.purpose: Distinguishes decoration style for merchandising and for setting customer expectations on customization options.
definitions.vision_guidance: Classify the primary decoration technique visible, not every individual decorative element - one dominant technique per image.
definitions.ai_guidance: Draft status - this attribute is not yet promoted to active use; downstream consumers should treat its value as provisional.
definitions.mapping_guidance: No mapping guidance yet - draft attributes are not distributed to Shopify or ERP until promoted to active.

confidence_expectations.notes: Draft attribute - confidence expectations not yet calibrated against real extraction runs.

search_behaviour.notes: Not yet exposed to search while draft.

definitions.business_definition: A numeric embedding representing this image's visual content, for similarity/visual search.
definitions.purpose: Enables nearest-neighbor visual search and recommendation without requiring a human-readable category match.
definitions.vision_guidance: Not applicable - this attribute is produced by an embedding model, not the vision extraction prompt.
definitions.ai_guidance: Treat as an opaque numeric vector - never interpret individual dimensions as meaningful in isolation.
definitions.mapping_guidance: Not distributed to Shopify or ERP - consumed only by the future Vector Search / Similarity Search build (WS-10/11).

confidence_expectations.notes: Confidence is not a meaningful concept for a raw embedding - see EAL's own Confidence_Standard.md precedent for vector-typed attributes.

search_behaviour.notes: Searched via nearest-neighbor similarity, not text/facet matching.

definitions.business_definition: The overall geometric shape of the cake (round, square, heart, number/letter, character).
definitions.purpose: Historically used for shape-based merchandising filters; superseded by a more granular shape+theme classification.
definitions.vision_guidance: Deprecated - do not extract this attribute for new images; superseded by domain.bakery.classification.shape_theme.
definitions.ai_guidance: Deprecated attribute - downstream consumers should migrate to its replacement rather than reading this value for new decisions.
definitions.mapping_guidance: No longer distributed to Shopify or ERP as of its deprecation.

confidence_expectations.notes: Historical extraction quality was high; not relevant to new extractions since deprecation.

search_behaviour.notes: Removed from active search facets on deprecation.

definitions.business_definition: The primary edible medium used for the cake's structure (sponge, fondant-covered, cream-only).
definitions.purpose: Retired attribute, retained for historical Knowledge Graph lineage only.
definitions.vision_guidance: Retired - no longer extracted under any circumstance.
definitions.ai_guidance: Retired attribute - present only for historical records; must never be written by any new pipeline.
definitions.mapping_guidance: Not distributed to any downstream system.

confidence_expectations.notes: Retired before enough real extractions accumulated to calibrate a typical confidence.
